title: Brutal Drinks Frozen Mojito 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Brutal Drinks’ Frozen Mojito Nic Salt e-liquid delivers the crisp, refreshing taste of the classic Cuban cocktail with a vibrant blend of zesty Lime and fresh Mint. The cooling finish makes this e-liquid a perfect choice for vapers who enjoy complex, refreshing, drink-inspired flavours with a frosty twist. Crafted by Just Juice, the Brutal Drinks Nic Salts range pairs bold flavour profiles with a smooth nicotine salt formula. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Frozen Mojito Nic Salt is ideal for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod kits, offering fast-absorbing nicotine satisfaction with a soft throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid provides a versatile and refreshing vaping experience. Part of the Brutal Drinks collection, Frozen Mojito is one of several delicious flavours inspired by popular drinks, including Mango Lassi, Brutal Bull, and Blackcurrant Crush. Explore the full range to discover your next all-day vape.
